headline: JetBlue Raises Checked Baggage Fees on Caribbean and Latin American Flights
summary: JetBlue increased its checked baggage fees for flights to the Dominican Republic and other destinations across the Caribbean, Latin America, Canada, and the United States.
why: Ancillary fees are an important revenue stream for commercial airlines seeking to offset rising operating expenses.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways
impacts.why: Higher baggage fees can increase ancillary passenger revenues.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
